description: The pie chart titled "Distribution of data source in the combined training set" represents the proportion of different data sources used in the training set for a study on automatic evaluation of attribution by large language models. The chart is divided into eight slices, each representing a different data source with corresponding percentages. The largest slice, colored in blue, represents the "NQ" data source, accounting for 31.3% of the training set. The second-largest slice, in orange, is "SNLI" with 15.4%. The "VITAMINC" data source is shown in green with 13.0%, followed by "XSUMHUL" in light blue at 1.6%. The "SCIFACT" data source is represented by a small yellow slice at 0.1%. "ENTFA" is shown in red with 1.8%, "FACTCC" in purple at 2.6%, "ANLI" in light green at 4.6%, and "FEE" in dark green at 16.1%. The "PUBHEALTH" data source is the smallest, represented by a thin slice in pink at 0.5%. The "MULTINLI" data source is shown in a light orange slice at 11.3%, and the "MULTIFC" data source is represented by a thin slice in red at 0.5%. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled inside the corresponding slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
